_doc: The Gen 6 Exp. Share's text (b2tools/patches/exp_share.py; HoennB2's src/text lines, the same words), new lines appended by patches/sinnoh_names.py: system file 6 (the Bag's messages; word 1 = the item's name) and the team line in the battle std-message files 17 and 19, which must give it the same id (Black 2's file 17 has 221 lines, 19 has 201: 19 gets 20 filler lines first, as in HoennB2). exp_share.text_id() computes the ids from Black 2's line counts and these files' order. res/items/exp_share/data.json: the Bag's description, rewritten for the key item (Black 2's says it is held; the Exp. Share can't be held any more).

While it's on, every Pokémon on your
team gets Exp. Points from battles,
